semantics.timing: Pure combinational output; responds to current inputs without clock cycles or registered latency.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement.

numeric.operators: One-bit bitwise XOR followed by one-bit bitwise AND
numeric.arithmetic: No addition, overflow, rounding, truncation or saturation.

verification.compile: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite timeout.
verification.oracle: Independent hard-coded truth table for all four binary combinations.
verification.simulation: Drive each binary combination and compare settled z using case inequality; repeat combinations in reverse order to detect state dependence; finite simulation watchdog and process timeout.
verification.static_review: Confirm exact ports and widths, combinational expression, no storage or simulation-only DUT constructs.
